entry_safety: All twelve have phase3 source rows marked phase2_preflight and PREFLIGHT, but still require exact observed accepted species and photo/rights check. User source-pool approval does not override taxonomy/identity HOLD, and no county-range research is performed.

selected.look_here_first: Look for an open drooping oat panicle bearing individual large spikelets, often with long bent and twisted awns; examine florets and hairy callus.
Opposite toothed leaves on a nettle relative without stinging hairs; tight green flower clusters form slender cylinders along the leaf axils.
Annual brome with a loose nodding branched panicle and elongated awned spikelets; inspect lemma awns and blade/sheath hairs.
Low trailing plant with opposite ovate toothed leaves and small yellow composite heads from the leaf axils; inspect phyllaries and three-angled fruits.
Basal rosette of deeply lobed leaves, small four-petaled white flowers and strongly triangular to heart-shaped seedpods.
Deciduous tree with pinnate alternate leaves and elongated narrow toothed leaflets; inspect small hickory nuts, husk seams and twigs.
Large opposite or whorled heart-shaped leaves, branched clusters of tubular trumpet flowers, and very long slender pod-like capsules.
Grass with dense spiny burr-like groups of florets along a spike; inspect bristle fusion and burr spines, plus hairy ligule.
Broad bamboo-like grass blades and a drooping open inflorescence with distinct flattened oat-like spikelets hanging from slender stalks.
Alternate triangular-to-diamond leaves often dusted with mealy white coating; tiny green flowers crowd into clustered spikes.
Creeping stolons that root at nodes, narrow short leaves and several finger-like terminal flowering spikes; examine hairy ligule.
Dense basal rosette of stiff narrow strap leaves with repeated small marginal teeth, producing a towering flower stalk of tiny cream flowers.
